text:
Mistfall Hunter – Cinematic Launch Trailer
Mistfall Hunter, the dark fantasy extraction ARPG, has officially arrived on XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC. Start your hunt today with XBOX Game Pass as a Day One release, or take advantage of a 10% launch discount on the Standard and Deluxe Editions across all platforms until August 12.

https://www.xbox.com/games/store/mistfall-hunter/9p8x6tvw9zw8

Set in Weavereach, a shattered world where the gods have perished and the deadly Gyldenmist sweeps the realm, Mistfall Hunter invites you to take on the role of a Gyldhunter. Venture into the heart of the corruption solo or with up to two companions, defeating twisted creatures for their spoils or hunting rival Gyldhunters for their loot. The stakes are high: if you die, you lose everything. To secure a safe return to the Windrest, you must track down extraction opportunities hidden within the realm and ring the bell known as the Soul of Return to escape. But beware, the Gyldenmist may conceal more than one way out.

text:
Mirth Island - Story Trailer
When Dodo’s dream of becoming an actor falls apart, the young duck returns home to Mirth Island in search of a new purpose.

There, he discovers that the legendary theater that first inspired him has been left in ruins. Together with his childhood friends Vivi and Rita, Dodo sets out to restore the theater and bring its stage back to life.

Explore a colorful island filled with charming locals, adorable animals, and stories waiting to be discovered. Help the islanders with their everyday problems, form meaningful friendships, and enjoy playful rhythm minigames along the way.

Through perseverance, friendship, and small acts of kindness, Dodo may discover that rebuilding the theater could also help him heal his own heart.
